blocks.text: Change review. Describe one implemented extension, the requirement it satisfies, the regression that would catch a broken implementation, and the effect on ownership or lifetime. Separate behavior changes from refactoring.

blocks.text: Operational limits. State plainly that the reference capstone does not implement persistence, authentication, concurrent access, or unbounded-input protection. Identify what would need to change before valuable real data depended on it.

Any instruction supplied only from memory is a documentation defect to repair. A complete acceptance review describes both what works and the boundary beyond which no claim has been established.
